name: Zed
notes: Death Mark opens the fight at t=0: Zed is held from attacking and from casting during the 0.6s cast delay plus the 0.35s dash, the mark applies to the dummy the instant the dash ends, and its 100% AD + stored-damage detonation lands 3 seconds later.

Death Mark's Shadow is used to persist 8s, computed from the sheet's RShadowDurationDisplayed (7.5s) + RReactivateCD (0.5s); this disagrees with the wiki's stated 9s text, and the sheet's calculated figure is used instead (see assumed).

Razor Shuriken has a 0.25s cast time (its damage lands as the cast starts, then it keeps Zed busy for 0.25s, per the guide's cast-time rule): no other cast and no attack starts during it, but the guide's cast-time rule is not violated by mimicry since a Shadow's mimicked shuriken is not a separate cast by Zed and adds no further busy time.

Living Shadow (W) is cast on cooldown purely for its 5.25s Shadow: like Death Mark's Shadow, it automatically mimics every Razor Shuriken cast against the target as a full, un-reduced hit, so up to two mimicked Q instances (one from each Shadow) can land per Q cast. Living Shadow itself has no cast time and does not hold up other casts, but still waits its turn behind one in progress.

Shadow Slash does not multiply with mimicry: per the wiki, only one slash's damage lands per E cast no matter how many Shadows also slash the target, so E deals a single damage instance each cast regardless of active Shadows. Shadow Slash has no cast time either.
Shadow Slash reduces Living Shadow's current (remaining) cooldown by 3s per champion hit, applied to W's remaining cooldown on every E cast against the dummy.

Death Mark's stored-damage detonation totals Zed's own Q, E and Contempt for the Weak instances (including mimicked Q casts) that land during the 3s Marked for Death window; basic-attack damage during the mark is not included in the store, a conservative simplification since the engine does not expose per-attack damage amounts to the driver.
Contempt for the Weak triggers on a basic attack landing while the dummy is below 50% max health, on a 10s internal cooldown; its bonus magic damage does not critically strike.
Energy costs are not modeled: no source here gives Zed's max energy or regen, and the rotation (R once, Q/E/W on cooldown) is judged plausible within an 8-15s fight.

Razor Shuriken's reduced pass-through damage to targets beyond the first only matters with multiple enemies; against the single dummy every hit (Zed's or a Shadow's) is a full first hit, so the reduction is unused here.
Living Shadow's and Death Mark's Shadow Swap recast is a repositioning blink with no damage effect on a stationary target and is not modeled.

assumed.why: the sheet's calculated field (RShadowDurationDisplayed 7.5 + RReactivateCD 0.5 = 8s) is used over the wiki's stated 9s prose, since the two disagree and the sheet's computed value is treated as authoritative
